function.name: save_new_patient
function.description: Register a new patient in the system. By default uses the caller's phone number, but if the patient provides a different phone number (e.g., they're calling from someone else's phone), use the phone parameter.

phone.description: The patient's phone number, if different from caller ID. Only include if patient explicitly provides a different number.
